from tiny_perceptron.retrieval import lexical_terms,retrieve
from collections import Counter
query='書店地址'
docs=[{'id':'d1','text':'貓喜歡曬太陽'},{'id':'d2','text':'書店地址是青街8號'}]
print('查詢片段',lexical_terms(query))
print('取回',retrieve(query,docs,k=1))
print('改問法',retrieve('營業處在哪',docs,k=1))
print('repeat書score',sum(min(Counter(lexical_terms('書'*10))[t],n) for t,n in Counter(lexical_terms(query)).items()))
print('mixed terms',lexical_terms('AbC17 23 書店'))
